exams.name: Medical licensing examination (USMLE or equivalent)
exams.notes: Board may identify accepted examinations, set passing standards, and set limits on time and numbers of attempts by rule. IMLC eligibility requires passing USMLE or COMLEX-USA within three attempts.

exams.quote: An applicant shall satisfy the Board's requirements for medical licensing examination as established by the Board by rule. The Board may identify which examinations are accepted, set passing standards, and set limits on time and numbers of attempts for exams.

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice medicine by the Board shall apply biennially for the renewal of his or her license.

required.quote: A licensee for renewal of an active license to practice medicine shall have completed continuing medical education that shall meet minimum criteria as established by rule, by the Board

hours_per_period.quote: The Board shall require a minimum of 10 hours of continuing medical education by rule.

period_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice medicine by the Board shall apply biennially for the renewal of his or her license.

available.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for physician licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States, regardless of whether that jurisdiction has licensing requirements substantially equal to those of this State

requirements.value: Not more than three years of practice in good standing in another U.S. jurisdiction; must meet postgraduate training requirements (2 years for U.S./Canadian graduates, 3 years for international graduates in accredited U.S./Canadian program).
requirements.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for physician licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States, regardless of whether that jurisdiction has licensing requirements substantially equal to those of this State, provided the applicant meets one of the following postgraduate training requirements

credential_type.quote: "Licensing" and "licensure" mean a process by which a statutory regulatory entity grants to a person who has met certain prerequisite qualifications the right to perform prescribed professional or occupational tasks and to use the title of the profession or occupation. Practice without a license is unlawful.
credential_type.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 57 - Review of Regulatory Laws

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or renewing a medical license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a medical license or in connection with applying for or procuring periodic renewal of a medical license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising health care services in a manner intended to mislead or deceive the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: all advertising about health care services or a medical business that is intended or has a tendency to mislead or deceive the public or impose upon credulous or ignorant persons and so be harmful or injurious to public morals or safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: abandonment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that impair the licensee's ability to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting sale of drugs or devices to exploit a patient for financial gain, or prescribing drugs for non-therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: promotion by a physician of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a patient in such a manner as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician or selling, prescribing, giving away, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that evidences unfitness to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct that evidences unfitness to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully making and filing false reports or records in his or her practice as a physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to promptly make patient records available upon proper written request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to make available promptly to a person using professional health care services, that person's representative, succeeding health care professionals, or institutions, when given proper written request and direction of the person using professional health care services, copies of that person's records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for professional services for any person for bringing to or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful misrepresentation in treatments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willful misrepresentation in treatments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine with a physician who is not legally practicing within the State, or aiding such physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing medicine with a physician who is not legally practicing within the State, or aiding or abetting such physician in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross overcharging for professional services on repeated occasions, including filing false statements for collection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross overcharging for professional services on repeated occasions, including filing of false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetency resulting from physical or mental impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetency resulting from physical or mental impairment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting one's name or license to be used by a person or entity not under one's active oversight
disciplinary_grounds.quote: permitting one's name or license to be used by a person, group, or corporation when not actually in charge of, responsible for, or actively overseeing the treatment or other health care services provided

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated failure to use the degree of care, skill, and proficiency commonly exercised by an ordinary skillful physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: in the course of practice, gross failure to use and exercise on a particular occasion or the failure to use and exercise on repeated occasions, that degree of care, skill, and proficiency that is commonly exercised by the ordinary skillful, careful, and prudent physician engaged in similar practice under the same or similar conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or other disciplinary sanction by another jurisdiction on grounds listed in this section
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revocation of a license to practice medicine or surgery, or other disciplinary sanction, by another jurisdiction on one or more of the grounds specified in this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order of the Board or violation of any term or condition of a restricted or conditioned license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with an order of the Board or violation of any term or condition of a license that is restricted or conditioned by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of the profession when medically or psychologically unfit to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practice of profession when medically or psychologically unfit to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegation of professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, education, or licensing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: delegation of professional responsibilities, including delivery of any health care services, to a person whom the licensed professional knows, or has reason to know, is not qualified by training, experience, education, or licensing credentials to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime related to the practice of the profession, or any felony, or failure to report such conviction within 30 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime related to the practice of the profession or conviction of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of the profession, or failure to report to the Board a conviction of any crime related to the practice of the profession or any felony in any court within 30 days of the conviction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing prescriptions or medical services electronically without establishing a proper physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: providing, prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing medical services or prescription medication or prescription-only devices to a person in response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide information the Board reasonably requests in furtherance of its statutory duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to provide to the Board such information it may reasonably request in furtherance of its statutory duties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior that interferes with patient care or could adversely affect quality of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disruptive behavior that involves interaction with physicians, hospital personnel, office staff, patients, or support persons of the patient or others that interferes with patient care or could reasonably be expected to adversely affect the quality of care rendered to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any sexual misconduct that exploits the physician-patient relationship, including sexual contact with a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commission of any sexual misconduct that exploits the physician-patient relationship, including sexual contact with a patient, surrogates, or key third parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, or dispensing controlled substances for the licensee's own use or to an immediate family member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, ordering, or dispensing any drug legally classified as a controlled substance for the licensee's own use or to an immediate family member as defined by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a blank or undated prescription form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: signing a blank or undated prescription form

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of conversion therapy on a client younger than 18 years of age
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of conversion therapy as defined in 18 V.S.A. § 8351 on a client younger than 18 years of age

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with notice, disclosure, or advertising requirements for administering unapproved stem cell products
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with one or more of the notice, disclosure, or advertising requirements in 18 V.S.A. § 4502 for administering stem cell or stem cell-related products not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to practice competently, including unsafe patient care or failure to conform to essential standards of acceptable and prevailing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performance of unsafe or unacceptable patient care; or failure to conform to the essential standards of acceptable and prevailing practice.

definition_quote.value: using the designation "Doctor," "Doctor of Medicine," "Physician," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination thereof in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition; advertising, holding out to the public, or representing in any manner that one is authorized to practice medicine; offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine; offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person, including the management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care; offering or undertaking to perform any surgical operation upon any person; rendering a written or otherwise documented medical opinion concerning the diagnosis or treatment of a patient; or rendering a determination of medical necessity or a decision affecting the diagnosis or treatment of a patient.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means: (A) using the designation "Doctor," "Doctor of Medicine," "Physician," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination thereof in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition

value: prescribing, ordering, giving, or administering drugs or medicine
preventing, diagnosing, correcting, or treating disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition by any means, methods, or devices
management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care
rendering medical opinions concerning diagnosis or treatment
telemedicine (rendering treatment to patients in-state via electronic transmission)
methods_authorized.quote: offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person, including the management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care

drug_authority.value: May prescribe, order, give, or administer drugs or medicine for the use of any other person; may not prescribe controlled substances for own use or to an immediate family member
drug_authority.quote: offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person

license_status_types.quote: An applicant for a limited training license to practice medicine in a postgraduate training program

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of medical schools outside the U.S. or Canada must complete at least three years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian accredited program (vs. two years for U.S./Canadian graduates) and must submit evidence of ECFMG certification, unless qualifying as a Fifth Pathway applicant.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A graduate of a Board-approved medical school outside the United States or Canada shall submit evidence of success of completing at least three years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board... A graduate of a medical school outside the United States or Canada shall also submit evidence of certification by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian medical school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Providing prescriptions via electronic means is permitted only when the licensee makes a reasonable effort to verify patient identity, establishes a documented diagnosis through accepted medical practices, and maintains a current medical record. An electronic or telephonic evaluation by questionnaire alone is inadequate for initial patient evaluation, with enumerated exceptions (e.g., newly hospitalized patients, call coverage, advanced practitioner support, medication abortion via adaptive questionnaire, short-term continuation for new patients, emergencies).
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: providing, prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing medical services or prescription medication or prescription-only devices to a person in response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship: (i) a reasonable effort to verify that the person requesting medication is in fact the patient, and is in fact who the person claims to be; (ii) establishment of documented diagnosis through the use of accepted medical practices; and (iii) maintenance of a current medical record

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: This subchapter is the Vermont adoption of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact as revised by the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The Board or the Executive Director of the Board may waive supervision and scope of practice requirements for physician assistants, including the requirement for documentation of the relationship between a physician assistant and a physician pursuant to section 1735a of this title.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: All medical malpractice court judgments and all medical malpractice arbitration awards in which a payment is awarded to a complaining party during the last 10 years, and all settlements of medical malpractice claims in which a payment is made to a complaining party within the last 10 years.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Any hospital, clinic, community mental health center, or other health care institution in which a licensee performs professional services shall report to the Board, along with supporting information and evidence, any reportable disciplinary action taken by it or its staff.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: the Board shall use at least $25.00 of this fee to support the cost of maintaining the Vermont Practitioner Recovery Network, which, for the protection of the public, monitors and evaluates, coordinates services for, and promotes rehabilitation of licensees who have or potentially have an impaired ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require a licensee or applicant to submit to a mental or physical examination, and an evaluation of medical knowledge and skill by individuals or entities designated by the Board if the Board has a reasonable basis to believe a licensee or applicant may be incompetent or unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety.
